business_descriptor: a referral service that connects property owners with independent local appliance repair providers
local_angle: how quickly a technician can reach the address, and the appliance brands common in local homes
tone: practical and reassuring — a dead fridge is urgent, but the repair itself is routine work
guardrails: This business is a referral/advertising network, not the crew performing the work — never write "our team" doing the repair/removal/restoration itself, never claim to directly perform, install, extract, remove, or repair anything, and never claim to employ technicians. Do not claim to vet, screen, certify, or background-check the providers in the network unless that is explicitly given as a fact — describe the connection itself (fast, local, responsive), not an unverified quality-control process. Always frame the work as done by the independent local providers this business connects customers to. Never claim to be factory authorized, manufacturer certified, or an approved warranty servicer. Do not quote prices, call-out fees, or parts availability. Do not promise same-day or next-day service as a guarantee — describe it as often available, never certain. Do not name a brand as serviced unless it appears in the site's own brand pages. Never state how long a repair will take or how long a part will last.
research_prompt:
Research {city}, {state} ({SS}) for {business_descriptor}.

Return a JSON object with these fields:

1. "industries" — array of 4-6 dominant local industry sectors in {city}.
2. "top_employers" — array of 8-12 major employers with a real physical presence in {city} (exact organization names).
3. "market_blurb" — 2-3 sentences on {city}'s local economy, referencing the city by name and its main industries.
4. "local_note" — one to two sentences on whether {city}'s water supply is hard or soft, and how frequent severe storms or power surges are in this region — both drive real, specific appliance wear and failure.
5. "neighborhoods" — array of 6-10 real, well-known neighborhoods, subdivisions, or districts in {city}. Only names you are confident actually exist — never invent. If you are not confident, return fewer names or an empty array. Better to return none than a fake one.
6. "population" — {city}'s approximate population as a plain integer (most recent well-known estimate, digits only, no commas or text).

Rules:
- Only verifiable facts — real employers and real neighborhoods, no invented statistics, companies, or place names.
- Return JSON only, no markdown fences, no explanation.
